item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
• This version requires macOS Monterey 12 or later 🍎
  • Add smart typing shortcuts for flagged (!f) and urgent (!u) reminders 🚩 ⏰
  • Add keyboard navigation between reminder fields using Tab and Shift-Tab ⌨️
  • Improve type-to-create support, including non-Latin characters ✏️
  • Fix text field resizing when creating reminders on macOS Golden Gate 27 🐛
  • Add an option to display notes in the reminder list 📝
  • Add an option to close the popover after creating a reminder ✨
  • Display links found in reminder titles and notes alongside attached links 🔗
  • Fix launch at login migration and unexpected termination 🐛
  • Fix reminder time being overwritten when marking a reminder as urgent 🐛
  • Other minor improvements in code ⚡

item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
• Fix an issue where the next reminder occurrence could be incorrectly shown and saved as completed 🐛
  • Fix a scenario that could cause Mission Control to show an empty window 🐛

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
• Automatically open the create view when typing on the keyboard ⌨️
  • Improve completion animation and add setting to disable it ✨
  • Add support for flagged reminders 🚩
  • Add support for urgent reminders ⏰
  • Fix "Show all reminders count" in menu bar 🐛
  • Other minor improvements in code ⚡

Details

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
• Redesigned interface with a dedicated settings window 🎨 ⚙️
  • Auto-update support via Sparkle 🔄 ✨
  • Add full Tags support: view, edit, search, and filter 🏷️
  • Display next upcoming reminder title in the menu bar 📌
  • Drag to resize the popup window ↕️ ↔️
  • Search across all reminders 🔍
  • Copy reminder option with configurable fields 📋
  • Add option to hide menu bar icon when counter is shown 🙈
  • New "Recent Reminders" section ⏪
  • Filter list menu stays open for multiple selections 🗂️
  • Edit and set recurrence rules for reminders 🔁
  • Animation when marking a reminder as completed ✨
  • Support 12-hour / 24-hour time format 🕐
  • Add advanced sorting options 🔃
  • Fix upcoming reminders with "all" option showing undated items 🐛
  • Fix reduce transparency option 🐛
  • Add translation for Filipino 🇵🇭 🌐
  • Add missing translations and other minor improvements in code ⚡
